### Intro call

Thirty minutes. You walk us through where coordination hurts; we show you what Ayven does about it. If it's not a fit, we'll say so.

### Ayven joins your team

We set Ayven up in your Slack or Teams together and start on the workflow that hurts most — the recurring chase, the status ritual, the handoff that keeps stalling.

03

### We build around you

Every other week we review what worked and what didn't, and what you need next goes onto the roadmap. You approve everything Ayven does — nothing ships without you.

## Frequently asked questions [...] Design partners

# Bring us the problem your operation can't shake.

Every operation has one: the handoff that always stalls, the status ritual that eats a day a week, the chasing nobody can switch off. We take on a small number of teams as design partners to solve exactly that — with Ayven built around how your team actually works, and both founders on the problem with you.

Who it's for

## You'll know if this is you

We're not looking for logos. We're looking for teams whose day is genuinely taxed by coordination — because that's who Ayven has to work for.

### You feel the chasing

Someone on your team spends real hours nudging work forward — “any update?”, “who owns this?”, “where's that doc?” — instead of doing the work itself.

### You live in Slack or Teams [...] ### You live in Slack or Teams

Ayven works where your coordination already happens. If your team's day runs through Slack or Microsoft Teams, you're in the sweet spot.

### You're roughly 5–100 people

Big enough that coordination hurts, small enough that we can work with you directly. Remote and hybrid teams tend to feel it most, but neither is required.

The exchange

## What you get, what we ask

A design partnership only works when it's honest in both directions. Here's the whole deal — there's no fine print behind it.
